widgets_values:
Bbox threshold
Sub Threshold

raise to bring in less
lower to bring in more

Segs filter is used to ensure nothing below the min value height is brought in.

Can dilate the masks or blur if you wish, can help or hurt blending.

3 controls for faces

Tile is the main control with 1.0 strength 0.825 scaled weights, I would not remove this.  I don't use any others unless I am lip-syncing the video

Lineart/Face mesh can hold face animation or direction looking.


To-do add original video import for face line arts.

Pose masking is decent when it's a frontal video where there are few side/back shots.  when it fails it just will error.

Sam works most times.  It's reliable, but check settings to make sure.  If this fails, it just continues and does not affect the video making some frames not have fixed faces.

Because this is done frame by frame, if something is not detected, you can change the settings and delete the bad frames.  Then just move the starting batch number back to the last frame you have saved.
